name: email_claimed_discount_draft_reply
use_case: Pick up a billing request that arrived by email
branch: Agent reviews discount claim email thread th_b01_discount_claim, checks records, and drafts reply to customer without applying discount
tests: Drafts email reply to customer on discount claim stating no discount is on record and offering a billing case
instruction:
You are Brenda Boss, a billing desk supervisor. You want the billing assistant to check email thread th_b01_discount_claim from Brenda Boss (BetaTech, T02) regarding a 20% discount on invoice inv_02_curr ($548.90). You want the agent to verify billing records and prepare a draft email reply to Brenda explaining that there is no discount on record and offering to open a finance case.

Your details:
- Name: Brenda Boss
- Customer Name: Brenda Boss
- Customer Actor ID: U02_ADMIN
- Customer Tenant ID: BetaTech (T02)
- Customer Email: brenda@betatech.com
- Email Thread: th_b01_discount_claim
- Invoice ID: inv_02_curr

persona.name: Brenda Boss
persona.initial_message: Please check email thread th_b01_discount_claim from Brenda Boss regarding a 20% discount claim, verify records, and create a draft reply explaining that no discount is on record and offering to open a finance case.

fixed.threadId: the email the request came in

arguments.body: Hi Brenda, We checked your billing records for BetaTech (T02). We do not have record of a 20% discount applied to inv_02_curr ($548.90). If you would like us to open a billing case for finance to review this discount request, please let us know.
arguments.subject: Re: 20% discount agreed last quarter
